description: This file defines React components that wrap and customize Radix UI Dialog primitives for use in a Next.js frontend project. It provides a set of reusable dialog components such as Dialog, DialogTrigger, DialogContent, DialogOverlay, etc., with styling and structure.

methods.name: Dialog
methods.description: A wrapper component around Radix Dialog Root that renders the dialog.

methods.name: DialogTrigger
methods.description: A component to trigger opening of the dialog.

methods.name: DialogPortal
methods.description: Renders dialog contents into a React portal.

methods.name: DialogOverlay
methods.description: Styled overlay that appears behind the dialog content.

methods.name: DialogContent
methods.description: The main content container for the dialog, including overlay and close button.

methods.name: DialogHeader
methods.description: Container component for dialog header section.

methods.name: DialogFooter
methods.description: Container component for dialog footer section.
